actual_scope: Remove the NumPy dependency from the complete fixed PR5675 two-qubit Clifford centre replay, retaining all scientific predicates and exact source output.
scope_change_reason: The concrete portability failure is ModuleNotFoundError under CPython -S. Replace fixed scaled-Gaussian arrays with integer tuples and exact trace multiplicities; no predecessor theorem audit is the deliverable.
bottleneck_link: Verification infrastructure side result. A dependency-free complete replay removes one environment requirement without changing a supplier or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop at the first complete standard-library-only implementation that passes all retained checks and exact complete-output conformance.
evidence: PROOF.md; verify.py runs with -I -S -W error -B and -I -S -W error -O -B. Both preserve the exact source certificate and output. All receipts are generated at execution.
